description: MtaStsEnforcer builds reqwest::Client with redirect::Policy::none() and no custom CA. RFC 8461 §3.3 explicitly forbids following redirects (an attacker could redirect the policy fetch to a controlled server) and requires WebPKI certificate validation (the HTTPS channel IS the trust anchor). A future contributor might 'improve' this by following redirects for convenience. Do not change it. The no-redirect and WebPKI invariants are the only things making the MTA-STS policy fetch trustworthy.
title: No-redirect + WebPKI-only HTTP client in MtaStsEnforcer is correct and must be preserved
